articles.title_en: Liverpool earn first league win at Anfield with victory over Brighton
articles.title_ja: Liverpool earn first league win at Anfield with victory over ブライトン
articles.summary_ja: An own goal from ブライトン's パスカル・グロス swiftly followed by a goal from Alexander Isak, sees Liverpool beat the Seagulls 2-0 at Anfield to move into the Premier League top four.
